bbc_news_ai_filtered.title: BBC News AI Filtered
bbc_news_ai_filtered.description: AI Filtered Articles combined into a single feed.

articles.title: GB's Glave and Azu claim European 100m one-two
articles.description: Great Britain's Romell Glave and Jeremiah Azu claim a sensational European 100m one-two for the hosts in Birmingham.

articles.title: Rescuers scramble for survivors with 180 dead in Colombia earthquake
articles.description: Colombia experienced a number of aftershocks on Tuesday, as efforts continued to free survivors trapped in rubble and buildings.

articles.title: Eclipse chasers scramble for glasses as stocks run low
articles.description: Specialist glasses are all but sold out online ahead of the UK's most significant eclipse since 1999.

articles.title: Summer 2026 on course to be UK's hottest on record, says Met Office
articles.description: Only average conditions are needed for the remainder of August to break the record, which was set just last year.

articles.title: AI agent hacks gym to get its user a spot in pilates class
articles.description: The incident is being seen as the latest example of the AI tools going to any lengths to complete their tasks.

articles.title: When and where to see the solar eclipse in Scotland
articles.description: Up to 95% of the Sun will slowly disappear behind the Moon in the most dramatic eclipse visible from the UK since August 1999.

articles.title: Perseid meteor shower reaches peak: When and where to catch a glimpse
articles.description: On Wednesday night the Perseids will peak offering the best chance of seeing a 'shooting star'.

articles.title: GB's Hunt comes of age with European 100m gold
articles.description: Britain's Amy Hunt has her "coming of age" moment as she storms to 100m glory at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

articles.title: Ingebrigtsen returns from 'lowest of lows' to clinch 5,000m gold
articles.description: Jakob Ingebrigtsen fights back from "the lowest of lows" to win a stunning 5,000m gold at the European Championships after almost a year out with injury.
